L1h.claim: After a z>=8, >=5x volume down minute, the first full take-back on less volume within 5 minutes is followed by a bounce that a 1-minute-late taker entry can still earn
L1h.rule: is3_lshock rows(R[z>=8], 'x1'), author exit, 60 min; card passes = net of 10 bp fees + 2x modelled slippage > 0, p<0.05, better than the same drops without the pattern (p<0.05), net positive without the best 3 days. Both confirmT and confirmC must pass. Not clean: z=8 d=1 at-the-close was seen on all coins and years before; d=2..5 and the late entry were not.

L1f.claim: The bounce is coin-specific: long the coin, short BTC for 15 minutes after the d=1 reversal earns more than four taker legs
L1f.rule: is3_lshock q.h15-q.b15, z>=8, d=1, alts; card passes with 20 bp fees + 2x slippage; both confirm samples

W1f.claim: A Sunday 16-18 New York move of >= 0.5% made on less volume than the two hours before continues until Monday 17:00 NY
W1f.rule: is3_weekend confirm(); follow; card passes (net of taker 13 bp, p<0.05, better than the same rule on Thursdays, ex-top3) in confirmT and confirmC. Found in explore as the opposite of the author claim; 2024-25 partly seen via W3 (12-18 move, no volume split).

T1k20.claim: A bid resting 20 sigma (24h std of 1-min returns) below the last minute close, filled only if price trades 30 bp through it, is worth more 60 minutes later
T1k20.rule: is3_ladder confirm(); net of 2 bp maker + 5 bp taker + modelled slippage; card passes in confirmT and confirmC; also report max(limit, minute close) entries, which must be positive for a book

T1k30.claim: Same with 30 sigma (dose-response: should be larger than T1k20)

T1f_k20.claim: The frozen T1k20 rule also earns on coins that were later delisted
T1f_k20.rule: robustness check of a passed form: pooled result with confirmC must stay net positive with p<0.05; LUNA's last days count

T1f_k30.claim: The frozen T1k30 rule also earns on coins that were later delisted

T1g_k20.claim: The frozen T1k20 rule earns on 60 fresh coins

T1g_k30.claim: The frozen T1k30 rule earns on 60 fresh coins
T1g_k30.rule: same; plus positive in the pessimistic entry

T1i.claim: The T1k30 rule (resting bid 30 sigma under the last minute close, 30 bp trade-through) on a causal universe, top 20 coins by 30-d volume at the previous day's close, earns after costs 60 minutes later, in 2024-25 and then in 2026
T1i.rule: is3_ladtop build + confirm(): net of 2 bp maker + 5 bp taker + modelled slippage, card passes (p<.05, net>0, ex-top3) on confirmT = 2024-25 first; only then the 2026 vault, once. 2024-25 fills of parts of this universe were already seen (T1k30, T1g; 2025-10-10 is known to be bad), so confirmT is weak evidence and the vault is the real one; if confirmT fails the vault stays closed and T1 is OPEN. Also reported, not gating: pessimistic entry max(limit, minute close), account SR / worst day, top-10, age>=365, holds 15/240.

T5e_upspike_z8_b2_h60.claim: 1-min up-spikes that are not alone continue: long 60 min after a >= 8 sigma up minute when >= 1 other coin of the universe spiked >= 3 sigma up in the same minute beats same-coin 3-5 sigma up moves, after taker costs
T5e_upspike_z8_b2_h60.rule: event = minute q with log r >= 8 x 24-h sigma (shift 1) and breadth (same-minute same-direction >= 3 sigma events among the build universe) >= 2; one event per coin per 15 min; entry close of q+1, exit close of q+61; base = 3 same-coin up moves of 3-5 sigma; pass = is3_lib.card

params.explore: +27.2 bp vs -2.2, diff +29.4, p .002, n 994, all years > 0
params.caveat: breadth >= 2 chosen AFTER seeing the explore breadth split (lone +2.5, 2-3 +45.5, 4+ +22.1 bp); z >= 8 from the queue text (8-12). confirmC breadth is counted among 73 coins (more likely to be >= 2 than among 10)

O1e_ladder_rsi50.claim: the live ladder (T1k30 resting bid 30 sigma below, one-bar-late fills) earns more at 60 min when the coin is not in a pinned-down state: prior-day daily RSI14 >= 50 vs < 50 (InSilico: do not fade full-retard downside)
O1e_ladder_rsi50.rule: fills from data/is3/e2_k-30.parquet; event = fills with rsi14(daily bnall close).shift(1) >= 50 on the fill day; base = fills with < 50; gross = h60; card on confirmT 2024-01-01..2026-01-01 once

params.note: explore saw 3 RSI bins (+12/+73/+243 bp); the 50 cut is the bin edge seen; the unconditional ladder already used 2024-25 as its confirm sample, the RSI split is new

N3f_absorption_long_5d.claim: absorption (wa 18.10.54(3) the one that absorbs is in control; tg:93 failed bad news): heavy taker selling over 3 days while price holds -> the passive buyer wins, price rises over the next 5 days more than for the same coin at the same trailing return
N3f_absorption_long_5d.rule: bnall clean, coins in the point-in-time top 100; imb = 2 taker_buy/volume - 1; z = (imb - 60d mean)/60d sd shift 1; event: sum of z over 3 days <= -2 and 3-day return >= 0; long at the close, 5 days; baseline: same coin, same trailing 14-day return decile, 3 matched; confirmT half-0 2024-25, confirmC half-1 2021-25, one run each

params.note: explore by year: diff +195 (2021), +253 (2022, p .02), -12 (2023); cross-sectional residual version failed (2021 only); dose monotone in the 3-day return (136/217/341 bp); thresholds -2 and 0 were the first and only ones tried

N5e_thin_low_long_4h.claim: R6 refined: a 4h new 20-bar low made on thin volume is undercut (stop-run) but price is higher 4 days later than for the same coin at the same trailing return
N5e_thin_low_long_4h.rule: COINS10-style 4h bars from Binance 1-min klines; event = low < min(prior 20 lows) and bar volume < median of prior 24 bars; long at the close, hold 24 bars; baseline same coin, same trailing-14-bar return decile, 3 matched; confirmT COINS10 2024-25, confirmC other klines_1m coins 2021-25; one run each

params.note: idea arose from N5 c in the same session (chosen after seeing thin vs heavy lows); per-year explore diffs +337/+135/+54 (only 2021 significant); 1h version failed the per-year rule and is not registered; effect below its MDE (236 bp)

M2b_long10_w43.claim: A >=10x jump in trades per 0.43% range bar on a slow down bar at the 24 h low (capitulation burst, his 701-at-the-low example) is followed by a rebound beyond what the same day, side and price path give: +50 bp vs matched at 60 min from 5 min late in 2021-23 (n=600, every year and coin +). Chosen from ~36 explore cells (3 widths x 3 doses x 2 sides x sub-1s or not); overlaps L1 liquidation fade.
M2b_long10_w43.rule: research/studies/is3_m2.py collect() on 2024-01-01..2026-01-01 (BTC ETH SOL micro bars, mbars_bad_days dropped); events = w 0.0043 range bars, duration >= 1 s (fast False), extreme True (bar low within the last 4 bars of the rolling 24 h low), side +1 (down bar), lr >= log 10; gross = late60 (buy 5 min after the bar close, sell 60 min later) minus the mean late60 of non-event bars (|lr| < log 2) in the same (coin, w, day_side_pl cell, fast, extreme); card on that diff, plus the raw late60 for the cost ladder. Script: /tmp/m2card.py logic, to be saved as research/studies/is3_m2.py confirm.

M2b_long10_w43_raw.claim: raw return of the same events (cost ladder reading)
M2b_long10_w43_raw.rule: same events as M2b_long10_w43, gross = late60

Explore 2021-23: flow SR 1.58 -> 2.14 (100th pct of 50 random masks, p .005), xsmom 1.19 -> 1.62 (99.5th of 200, p .009), every explore year + in both. The 1-day window was found in form b (2 and 3 days did nothing); -7% was fixed before any run; -5% / -10% also positive in flow, weaker in xsmom.

Pass: dSR >= +0.1 AND pct vs 200 same-share random masks >= 0.90 AND dropped-long next-day mean < kept-long mean in >= 2 of 2024/2025/2026.
